<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="drawer_cabinet_0">
  <!-- Units: meters -->

  <!-- Base dimensions -->
  <!-- Width (X): 0.75, Height (Z): 0.94, Depth (Y): 0.38 -->
  <!-- Origin at floor under middle of object: X across width, Y toward back, front faces -Y, Z up -->

  <!-- Cabinet parameters -->
  <!-- Wall thicknesses -->
  <material name="wood" value=""/>
  <material name="drawer_wood" value=""/>
  <material name="guide_metal" value=""/>

  <!-- Common inertial helper: approximate as uniform density boxes -->
  <!-- Inertia for box (mass m, dimensions a,b,c):
       Ixx = (1/12)*m*(b^2 + c^2), Iyy = (1/12)*m*(a^2 + c^2), Izz = (1/12)*m*(a^2 + b^2)
       with axes aligned to link frame: X right/left, Y back/front, Z up. -->

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Link: Cabinet Frame -->
  <!-- ===================== -->
  <link name="cabinet_frame">
    <!-- Collision geometry: back + sides + top + bottom with reasonable thickness -->
    <!-- We'll approximate cabinet shell as three main boxes:
         1) Back panel
         2) Left/right side panels
         3) Top and bottom panels
         plus an internal void is not explicitly modeled (URDF doesn't support booleans).
         This is a physical proxy. -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.47" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="38.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.17" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.17" iyz="0.0" izz="0.12"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.19" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 0.19"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.19" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 0.19"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 0.57"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.02 0.57"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.365 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.38 0.57"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.365 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.38 0.57"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.365 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.38 0.57"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.365 0 0.285" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.38 0.57"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.83" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.38 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.83" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.38 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.38 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.75 0.38 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Drawer definitions -->
  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Drawer sizing:
       Cabinet inside clearances (approx):
       Side thickness 0.02; back thickness 0.02; top/bottom 0.02.
       We'll set drawer width slightly smaller than cabinet outer:
       drawer_width = 0.75 - 2*0.02 = 0.71
       drawer_depth = 0.34 (proxy; slides inside cabinet, leaving front/back clearances)
       drawer_height per drawer segment:
         total clear height approx 0.94 - top/bottom 0.02 - 0.02 = 0.90
         stacked 3 drawers => about 0.30 each, with internal guides thickness ignored.
       We'll use drawer box height 0.28 and leave gap for bottom panels between drawers via frame.
  -->

  <!-- Drawer travel:
       slide out toward front (-Y). We'll define joint axis along Y (prismatic).
       Parent frame is at cabinet origin.
       We'll set drawer link frames such that at q=0 the drawer is inside:
       i.e., its center is at Y = -0.02 (slightly into the cabinet).
       Prismatic joint moves along +Y in URDF joint axis; to move out toward front (-Y),
       we set axis = -1 in Y (so positive joint value moves toward -Y).
  -->

  <!-- Drawer 1 (bottom) -->
  <link name="drawer_1">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="7.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.020" iyz="0.0" izz="0.008"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <!-- Outer drawer body -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.34 0.28"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.34 0.28"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer bottom panel / rail proxy (thin slab) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Drawer 2 (middle) -->
  <link name="drawer_2">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="7.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.020" iyz="0.0" izz="0.008"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.34 0.28"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.34 0.28"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Drawer 3 (top) -->
  <link name="drawer_3">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="7.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.020" iyz="0.0" izz="0.008"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.34 0.28"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.14" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.34 0.28"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.71 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Prismatic joints (slides toward front: -Y) -->
  <!-- ===================== -->

  <!-- Joint locations:
       Cabinet origin: floor under middle.
       Drawer centers at:
         Bottom drawer center Z ~ 0.02 + 0.28/2 + gap? We'll use:
           bottom drawer link frame Z origin at its bottom? We set link frame at drawer bottom center in Z? No: we set link inertial origin at z=0.14 meaning link frame origin is at drawer bottom plane.
           In link geometry, drawer box from z=0 to z=0.28.
       So joint origin for each drawer should place drawer bottom plane at appropriate Z.
  -->

  <!-- Bottom drawer: bottom plane Z = 0.02 (cabinet bottom thickness) + 0.02 spacing -->
  <!-- Use Z positions:
       bottom drawer bottom z = 0.04
       middle drawer bottom z = 0.34
       top drawer bottom z = 0.64
       Each drawer height 0.28 => centers at 0.18, 0.48, 0.78 respectively.
  -->
  <!-- At q=0, drawer is slightly inside: drawer frame origin Y= -0.02 + (joint displacement along axis). -->
  <!-- Since link geometry spans y from -0.17..+0.17 around link origin,
       set link origin Y so that drawer back isn't penetrating the cabinet back panel too much.
       Cabinet back panel is at Y=+0.19 (thickness 0.02) with inner void starting near +0.18.
       Drawer back at link_origin_y - 0.17 should be <= 0.18 => link_origin_y <= 0.35. We'll use -0.02 comfortably inside. -->
  <!-- Travel: allow 0.30 m out. axis moves toward front (-Y), so joint positive increases front extension. -->

  <joint name="joint_drawer_1" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="drawer_1"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.02 0.04" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.30" effort="120.0" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_drawer_2" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="drawer_2"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.02 0.34" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.30" effort="120.0" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_drawer_3" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="drawer_3"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.02 0.64" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.30" effort="120.0" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Guide rails proxy as extra collisions on frame (no joints) -->
  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Rails on sides to constrain collision behavior using fixed geometry -->
  <link name="guide_rails_proxy">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.47" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.001" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.010" iyz="0.0" izz="0.010"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Left rails -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.335 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="guide_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.335 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.335 0 0.48" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="guide_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.335 0 0.48" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.335 0 0.78" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="guide_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.335 0 0.78" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Right rails -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.335 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="guide_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.335 0 0.18" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.335 0 0.48" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="guide_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.335 0 0.48" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.335 0 0.78" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="guide_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.335 0 0.78" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.005 0.30 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="fixed_guide_rails" type="fixed">
    <parent link="cabinet_frame"/>
    <child link="guide_rails_proxy"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
